text:
Oh my gosh, look at that! There’s a baby!! And the man is holding him up high like he’s flying! I bet he’s gonna tickle him soon!

And there’s a lady sitting right next to them with her hair all bunched up in a bun—she looks super comfy. She’s wearing black and she’s watching the baby too! Maybe they’re family? Or friends having a picnic day?

Ohhh—and LOOK!!! There’s a stroller! It’s big and black and has wheels and a canopy! Is the baby gonna get in it later? Or did he just come out of it? Maybe there’s snacks inside! Or toys! Or even a secret compartment for cookies!!

They’re all sitting under a tree—it’s sooo tall and brown and twisty! The grass is green and soft and perfect for rolling around if you want to join them!

I wanna go play with the baby! Can we wave? Can we say hi?! He looks so cute when he’s being held up like that! Maybe he’ll laugh! Babies love laughing!

This is the BEST DAY EVER outside!!! 🌞👶
